text:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment
inspection I1, which must be performed every two
months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The first 
draft initiated by Mr. Helmut Canadian SISP, S/S specialist, first approval at 
02 Sep.1996, first review date 03 March 2002, 
and 2nd review date 15 Jan. 2006.
The document was updated by 
Ataka PS.
Safety Precautions
Presence the safety supervisor is 
 required.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, ... etc.
Current transformer must be isolated and proper grounded is required
Wear safety belt because there is danger 
 of falling off the top of the CT stack when cleaning insulators or checking 
 connections.
Caution: Secondary CT wiring could be energized 
 through back feeds, make sure secondary circuits is
 short circuited.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Tool set for tightness, 
 Fiberglass ladder, Silicagel
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Voltage indicator.
Work to be carried out
Check primary bus connections for tightness
Check for any signs of oil leaks
Check porcelains for chips, cracks, cementing, and fastenings
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces
Check for signs of overheating or flashovers.
